Full Trajectory Accuracy Evaluation

Source: R/06_metrics_trajectory.R
evaluate_trajectory_metrics.Rd

Evaluates trajectory preservation using pseudotime correlation, branch height discrepancy (RMSE), trajectory graph alignment, and gene expression patterns along lineages. If raw count matrices are provided, pseudotime, graphs, and lineage trees are automatically inferred directly from the scRNA-seq data.

Usage

evaluate_trajectory_metrics(
  ref_data,
  sim_data,
  cell_types_ref = NULL,
  cell_types_sim = NULL
)

Arguments

ref_data

Reference count matrix (genes x cells) OR numeric vector of pseudotimes.

sim_data

Simulated count matrix (genes x cells) OR numeric vector of pseudotimes.

cell_types_ref

Optional vector of reference cell types (for lineage tree inference).

cell_types_sim

Optional vector of simulated cell types (for lineage tree inference).

Value

A named list of trajectory accuracy metrics:

pseudotime_correlation

Spearman correlation between reference and simulated pseudotime.

tree_height_rmse

Root mean squared error of lineage tree branch heights.

graph_alignment

Concordance of pairwise graph distances along trajectory landmarks.

lineage_expression_fidelity

Mean correlation of gene expression trends along lineages.

Examples

data(example_scrna, package = "scSimEval")
evaluate_trajectory_metrics(example_scrna$ref, example_scrna$sim)
